newsitem.title: UK: Savills shares gain after sharp profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Savills shares gain after sharp profit rise.

text.p: Shares in estate agency Savills Plc rose on Tuesday as the company posted a sharp rise in yearly profits and said the current year had started strongly.
The stock was up 5-1/2p or five percent at 117-1/2 by 1025 GMT in volume of 742,507.
Pre-tax profit rose 84 percent to 7.6 million stg, compared with an analyst consensus of 5.8 million stg. The full-year dividend was raised 40 percent to 3.5p.
"This is an outstanding performance which results from the strategic direction set by the board and the energy, skill and commitment of our staff," said chairman Richard Jewson.

"The new year has started strongly in most areas of the business," he said, adding that the company would take advantage of present good trading conditions to consolidate its leading position in the market.
